name: Text then follow card
what: An upright promo in four beats: a first line types in word by word, three words stack up like a carousel and a sentence builds with its highlights; the picture then grows into a dark profile card with a Follow button that gets tapped, the camera zooms in, and the picture flies across a pill that ends as a full screen with the handle.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f6-f39 a first line, one word every 6 f (each rising and sharpening in 6 f); f41-f86 three stacked words, focus word sharp, neighbours small and blurred, stepping up at f52-f61 and f67-f76; f89-f135 a sentence word by word then dissolving backwards; f137-f152 the picture grows from a dot and a dark profile card pops in; f157-f190 the Follow button opens from a hairline, then Message; f200-f227 the camera zooms into the button (the measured scale and pan), Follow turns to Followed at f217-f219; f223-f233 the ground goes dark; f224-f253 the picture flies in as a ball and swings onto the pill, swapping Followed for the handle; f289-f308 it flies out as the pill opens into a full screen; hold to f335
